[[category:Infobox templates]]

===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{LightsaberForm
|image=
|name=
|alternate=
|number=
|founder=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

==Data Fields==
*image - Put an image depicting the form in use
*name - Put the name of the form
*alternate - Put any alternate names of the form, e.g. Soresu is an alternate name of [[Form III]]
*number - Put the number of the lightsaber form in Arabic numerals
*founder - Put the names of the persons/people who developed the form, e.g. the [[Yovshin Swordsmen]] developed [[Jar'Kai]]
*affiliation - Put the groups of users the form was affiliated with, e.g. [[Form IV]] was affiliated with the [[Jedi]]</noinclude>
